name: Paper Home Co.
summary: Paper Home Co., headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, specializes in the manufacturing and sale of corrugated cardboard products across the Kingdom. Its extensive product portfolio includes point-of-sale (POS) displays, custom die-cut boxes, wrap-around packaging, various trays, regular slotted containers, jumbo boxes, half-slotted containers, mill run sheets, and protective dividers and pads. The company also offers corrugated flutes in C, B, E, BC, and BE profiles. Paper Home Co. serves a diverse range of industries, such as poultry, industrial materials, fashion, delivery services, retail, and bottled water producers.
